applicant_utility.summary: This is Swinburne's umbrella doctoral stipend competition: one application puts you forward for both the Swinburne University Postgraduate Research Award and the Research Training Program Stipend, and winners automatically receive a tuition-fee scholarship for up to four years - which matters for internationals, who cannot rely on the domestic RTP Fees-Offset. The factor that decides most outcomes is not the form but the supervisor: the project must align with a named Swinburne research area and be signed off by a principal supervisor before submission. With Round 2 now closed (9 October 2026), realistic candidates should be building supervisor relationships for the next round.
applicant_utility.best_fit: First-class honours graduates and early-career doctoral researchers who can persuade a Swinburne principal supervisor to back their project.
application_readiness_checklist: Email prospective supervisors with a short, research-area-aligned pitch and a draft proposal months before the round opens
Secure a principal supervisor who will sign the HDR Research Proposal template
Brief at least two referees and confirm they will email reports to HDRrefereereports@swin.edu.au by the round's referee deadline
Get transcripts certified and assemble publication evidence before the portal opens
common_rejection_risks: Unsigned or late-completed HDR Research Proposal template
Referee reports arriving after the round's referee-report deadline, which falls a week after applications close
A project that does not clearly map to a Swinburne Research Strategy and Ecosystem area
Holding another living-cost stipend above 75 per cent of the RTP/SUPRA rate
English evidence expiring before the scholarship enrolment deadline
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The stipend is AUD 35,500 (2026 rate) for three years; relocation and thesis allowances are published without amounts, and visa, health cover and dependants' costs are not addressed on the page.
document_audit: Transcripts must be certified, with evidence of completion, not plain copies
Proof of citizenship/ID must be attached as a document, not just stated in the form
International and permanent resident applicants need English evidence valid until the enrolment deadline
Clinical Psychology and Doctor of Psychology applicants need four reports in total: two Swinburne referee reports plus two professional references
alerts: Applications closed 9 October 2026 but referee reports were still due 16 October - do not stand down referees immediately after submitting
Enrolment deadlines bite: domestic Round 2 offer holders must enrol by 26 February 2027 and internationals by 29 June 2027
Psychology streams carry a double documentation burden and a slightly different proposal workflow
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply online in an open round, select 'Swinburne Research Scholarships', attach the signed proposal and documents, and have referees email reports separately; current PhD students instead use the downloadable Current Student Application Form.
